context: A police officer briefs about a historical case
purpose: Teach: 澤/藩/狂っ/秘め/消極/格段/懇親/突っ込み

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 長期未解決の事件、澤家との関わりも噂されていました。
lines.en: A long-unsolved case. There were rumors of ties to the Sawa family.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Light pause between sentences. No inflection toward judgment — presenting fact. Steady eye contact, shoulders level. The voice of someone who has stated this before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当時の旧藩社会、秘めた利害が狂った行動を生んだ可能性は?
lines.en: In that old han system, could hidden interests and conflicts have driven these actions?
lines.style: Lean forward slightly on the question. Genuinely curious — not challenging. Thoughtful pace, testing the idea out loud. Soft uptick at the end, inviting the officer to think with him.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 消極的な証言が多く、捜査は格段に難航しました。
lines.en: We received a lot of reluctant testimony. The investigation got significantly harder from there.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no apology in the delivery. Factual recounting. Slight weight on 「格段に」 — acknowledging the real obstacle. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 郷土史家との懇親、突っ込み所が見つかりますか。
lines.en: When we spoke with local historians, did any inconsistencies come up?
lines.style: Direct but respectful. The tone of someone drilling down on a detail that matters. Slight pause before the question. Not aggressive — precise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。地道に積み上げます。
lines.en: Yes. We built up the evidence piece by piece.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No flourish. A small nod might accompany this. Voice settles on the commitment. The kind of closure that says this work continues, but here is the answer to what you asked.
